component.name: Headphone for All
component.summary: Hear every device in one headphone at the same time

description.p: A Bluetooth headphone plays audio from only one device at a time. Headphone for All mixes them in software: the headphone stays paired to one device, the hub, and every other device streams its own audio to the hub over the local network. The hub mixes all streams and plays the mix in the headphone.

ul.li: Hub mode: receive, mix and play the audio of several computers and phones at once
Sender mode: stream this computer's system audio (PipeWire) to a hub
Per-source volume, mute and priority, with live loss and latency figures
Hubs are found automatically on the local network
Pairing with a PIN or QR code; every stream is end-to-end encrypted
Low latency Opus audio with jitter buffering and clock-drift correction

description.p: Sender and hub apps are available for Linux, Windows, macOS, Android and iOS. Capturing audio on Linux needs a PipeWire session.
First public pre-release: mix the audio of several devices into one headphone over the local network. Not yet tested on real hardware; see the release notes for known limitations.
